text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a sustained rise in apiserver open fds in us-east1 starting ~08:12 UTC, causing TLS accept failures and controller-manager leader election flaps. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/cp/fd-usage . Appears correlated with a proxy config rollout ~2h ago. Any quick mitigation ideas? :warning:

sam: Can you paste `ss -s` and `ps aux | grep kube-apiserver`? Is this only control-plane nodes in us-east1 or global?

maya: Only us-east1 control-plane hosts. `ss -s` shows lots of ESTAB, many TIME_WAIT. Logs show `accept4: Too many open files` and TLS handshake errors.

jonas: We rolled out edge-proxy-config v3 at 06:10 — I saw an envoy tweak for keepalive/acceptor. Maybe half-open sockets not closing. @deploy-bot do we have the rollout ID?

deploy-bot: Rollout: edge-proxy-config v3 — started 2026-03-20T06:10:22Z, canary completed 06:30Z, phased rollout 06:30–07:45Z. No health checks failed during rollout.

li: Quick mitigation: increase LimitNOFILE in kube-apiserver systemd unit and bump conntrack. Commands:
```
sudo systemctl edit kube-apiserver --full
# set LimitNOFILE=65536
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
```
Also check `conntrack -L | wc -l` for SNAT table saturation.

maya: Pasting a log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:14:03Z apiserver[1]: accept: socket: too many open files
2026-03-20T08:14:03Z apiserver[1]: tls: handshake error from 10.10.2.45: remote error: internal error
```

sam: controller-manager observed leader election failures and restart loops — impacted a few controllers. We should avoid full cluster restart. Can we roll back the proxy change in us-east1 or restart only apiserver pods one at a time?

jonas: Rolling back proxy is low-risk. I can push rollback to the three cp nodes in us-east1; suggests draining not needed if we restart apiserver one-by-one. Also check envoy stats `/clusters?filter=listener` for too many connections.

maya: Rolling back on us-east1 now. I'll watch FD and conntrack.

incidents-bot: ALERT: apiserver_open_fds_high in us-east1 — 3/3 control-plane nodes above 80% of LimitNOFILE — 08:16 UTC — pages: infra-oncall

maya: After rollback — observed FD drop within ~40s on node-1, conntrack count down from 220k to 48k on that node. Controller-manager restarts slowed. Still monitoring other two nodes.

li: Follow-up: we'll create a transient systemd change to increase LimitNOFILE and open a config ticket to pin keepalive defaults on proxy. Also run a postmortem if rollback fixed it.

sam: Assigning follow-ups: infra to raise conntrack, platform to audit envoy acceptor settings, eng-sre to draft postmortem. Thanks everyone.

maya: Leaving notes in the incident channel, will update if we see re-occurrence. :white_check_mark:
